title: Marketing Efficiency Score™
tagline: Is your marketing an engine or a money pit? Score it across 7 channels.
description: 14 questions that score your website, SEO, email, content, ads, social and AI usage — and show where your biggest growth opportunities hide.

categories.label: Website
categories.recommendation: Treat your website as your best salesperson: clear headline, proof, one strong call-to-action per page and online booking.

categories.label: SEO & Local Visibility
categories.recommendation: Claim and fully complete your Google Business Profile, gather reviews weekly, and publish pages targeting the exact phrases your clients search.

categories.label: Email Marketing
categories.recommendation: Email your list at least twice a month with genuinely useful content. Your list is the only audience you own — use AI to make consistency effortless.

categories.label: Content & Social
categories.recommendation: Pick ONE platform where your clients actually spend time and post twice weekly using an AI-assisted content system — depth beats being everywhere.

categories.label: Paid Advertising
categories.recommendation: Only scale ads once tracking works: know your cost per lead and cost per customer, or you're buying mystery boxes.

categories.label: AI in Marketing
categories.recommendation: Use AI to multiply output: one client story becomes an email, three posts and a page section. Build the repurposing habit.

questions.text: Does your website consistently generate inquiries?

options.label: Yes — it's a reliable lead source

options.label: Yes — actively converting visitors to subscribers

bands.label: Marketing on Hope
bands.summary: Your marketing is sporadic, untracked and heavily dependent on referrals or luck. That means feast-or-famine revenue. The fix isn't doing MORE marketing — it's building one simple, consistent, measured system at a time.
actionPlan: Week 1: Ask your last 10 customers how they found you — that's your #1 channel.
Week 1: Claim and complete your Google Business Profile; ask 5 happy clients for reviews.
Week 2: Fix your website's headline and add one clear CTA to every page.
Week 2: Start collecting emails with a simple, genuinely useful lead magnet.
Week 3: Use AI to draft a month of content for ONE channel in one sitting.
Week 3: Send your first value-packed email to your list.
Week 4: Set up basic tracking: where did every inquiry this month come from?
Week 4: Book an AI Audit to design your full marketing engine.

bands.label: Active but Inefficient
bands.summary: You're doing real marketing — but inconsistency, weak follow-through and missing measurement are burning effort. Systemizing what already works will likely grow results more than any new channel would.
actionPlan: Week 1: Double down: identify your best-performing channel and cut the worst.
Week 1: Fix your weakest category from the breakdown below.
Week 2: Build an AI-assisted content system: 1 hour to draft 2 weeks of content.
Week 2: Add a welcome sequence so new subscribers hear from you automatically.
Week 3: Connect marketing to sales: every lead gets instant, automated follow-up.
Week 3: Set up a simple monthly scorecard: leads, source, cost, customers.
Week 4: Repurpose your best asset into 5 formats.
Week 4: Book an AI Audit to eliminate the manual work in your engine.

bands.label: Marketing Engine
bands.summary: You've built what most small businesses never do: consistent, measured, multi-channel marketing. Your next gains come from compounding — deeper automation, sharper conversion and AI leverage that lets you scale output without scaling hours.
actionPlan: Week 1: Audit funnel conversion at each step — fix the biggest drop-off.
Week 1: Review channel ROI and reallocate budget to winners.
Week 2: Add AI personalization to your email sequences.
Week 2: Turn your best performing content into an evergreen automated funnel.
Week 3: Test one new growth lever (referral program, partnership or new lead magnet).
Week 3: Automate your marketing reporting into a weekly AI summary.
Week 4: Document the whole engine so it runs without any one person.
Week 4: Book an AI Audit to find the advanced plays worth testing next.
